issue: Drik Panchang prints दुस्यु जियो मारी (twice), not a word; corrected to दस्यु on the sense, with no other witness (Bhakti Bharat copies Drik Panchang). जियो is also unclear.
our reading: दस्यु जियो मारी: slew the demon (Hiraṇyakaśipu).

issue: सबके हृदय विदारण: 'tearer of the hearts of all' is odd of the Lord; it may mean the demon's heart (chest), or 'terrifying to every heart' (हृदयविदारक).
our reading: you who tear open the hearts of all
alternatives: who tore open the demon's breast; who strikes terror into every heart
